run_audio_codec_training: run the audio codec training loop with a config file and experiment tag
train_autoencoder_model: train an AudioDec autoencoder model using the TrainMain class with GAN losses
train_vocoder_model: train a HiFiGAN or UnivNet vocoder model with a pre-trained analyzer checkpoint
train_denoise_model: train a denoising model using noisy and clean audio pairs with the denoise trainer
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume training from a saved checkpoint file using the resume argument
